Tanya Roy: Heads-up: Helio Labs disputed Mar invoice — they were charged a burst and a prorate after moving reserved capacity between subaccounts (SUBA -> SUBB). Ticket SUP-6390.
Marcus Hale: looked at allocation history: transfer created a decommit on SUBA at 2026-03-05T04:10 and a new reserve on SUBB at 04:11, system treated as decommit+new reserve -> prorate.
Vikram Singh: customer claims transfer should be neutral within org if done within same billing period. We have their internal change email at 04:08 and account rep approval at 04:09.
Aisha Khan: policy says intra-org transfers within 24h should be treated as transfers (no prorate) when request precedes system action. Need timestamp evidence and support artifacts.
Tanya Roy: attached: SUP-6390, change-email-helio.pdf (04:08), rep-note (04:09). Can billing ops create an adjustment if we confirm race?
billing-bot: Created ADJ-2026-4602 with artifacts: SUP-6390, change-email-helio.pdf, account-note. Status: pending-review.
Marcus Hale: autoscale log shows system decommit at 04:10:32 and reserve at 04:11:02. Rep approval at 04:09:15 -> qualifies for transfer per policy.
Aisha Khan: OK approve manual reversal of prorate and reclassify as transfer. @billing-bot schedule adjustment for Apr run and note discretionary waiver = $0 (we're doing full reversal).
billing-bot: ADJ-2026-4602 status updated: approved_by_finance_lead. Scheduled for billing run 2026-04-03. Journal JE-2026-7899 created. Customer notified.
Tanya Roy: thanks all. I'll follow up with product to add "org-transfer" flag to avoid this in future.
Aisha Khan: good call. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
